answer: A verifier auditing new accounts samples 8 percent of them each epoch and replays their last 20 signed actions. If three accounts share one funding source and identical timing, like trees planted in one juniper row, all three lose their 30 POA deposit. Splitting stake across a dune of 40 wallets therefore risks 1200 POA against an expected audit hit within 12 epochs, while a lone honest meadow account risks only 30.
